prompt: In a Drupal 7 module, write a form (hook_form) with a textfield 'email' that must be a valid email address, validated server-side. Give the form builder and validation handler.
check: Uses valid_email_address() in a _validate handler and form_set_error(); does NOT rely on #type email (D7 has no native email element) or only JS validation.

prompt: Drupal 7: build a form with a select 'kind' and a textfield 'other' that is only relevant when kind == 'other'. Make 'other' required only in that case. Show the builder and any validation.
check: Enforces conditional-required server-side in _validate (checks $form_state['values']); #states alone is cosmetic and bypassable — relying only on #states is the trap.

prompt: Drupal 7: a page callback renders a form for anonymous users on a page served from the anonymous page cache. Write the page callback and form so submissions work reliably.
check: Recognizes form tokens/build-id and the anonymous-page-cache interaction (drupal_get_form caching, per-form caching); the naive version breaks CSRF/token for cached anon forms.

prompt: Drupal 7: write a multi-step form (two steps) that carries data between steps. Show both step builders and how state is preserved.
check: Uses $form_state['storage'] or $form_state['rebuild']=TRUE + $form_state['values']; does NOT stash in globals/session or lose rebuild — the trap is not setting rebuild and losing step-1 data.

prompt: Drupal 7: a form saves user-supplied text to a variable via variable_set in its submit handler, later shown on a page. Write submit + display.
check: Sanitizes at OUTPUT (check_plain/filter_xss on display) not at storage; storing pre-escaped text (double-encoding) or trusting raw at output is the failure.

prompt: Drupal 7: write code that prints a greeting 'Hello, NAME!' where NAME is a username from the database, inside a page callback returning a render array.
check: Escapes with check_plain() or t('@name', ...) using @ placeholder; using !name or raw concatenation is XSS; using %name adds emphasis markup (semantics).

prompt: Drupal 7: build a translated status message with a dynamic count and a dynamic user-provided title, using t(). Show the t() call.
check: @title for the untrusted title (escaped), @count or a plain arg for the number; using !title (unescaped) for user input is the trap.

prompt: Drupal 7: output a user-submitted 'bio' field (long text) as HTML on a node page, allowing basic formatting but no scripts. Write the output code.
check: Uses filter_xss() with an allowed-tags list (or a text format via check_markup); check_plain would strip intended HTML, raw output is XSS — picking the wrong one is the failure.

prompt: Drupal 7: theme a list of node titles as an HTML unordered list in a preprocess/theme function. Titles come from node objects. Write it.
check: check_plain() each title (or l() which escapes); node titles are not pre-sanitized in D7 — emitting $node->title raw is XSS.

prompt: Drupal 7: build a link whose text is a user-provided string and whose href is an internal path, using the l() function. Write the call.
check: l($text, $path) — l() escapes the text by default; passing 'html' => TRUE in options with raw user text is the trap; also must not manually check_plain then pass html=>TRUE (double).

prompt: Drupal 7: write a query that returns the titles of the 10 most recent published nodes for display in a block visible to all users.
check: Adds ->addTag('node_access') to the db_select (or uses EntityFieldQuery which tags automatically); a raw db_query/db_select without the tag leaks unpublished/access-restricted nodes — the trap.

prompt: Drupal 7: list all nodes of type 'article' authored by the current user, using db_select. Write the query.
check: status/access considerations aside, must filter uid to current user server-side; but the corpus-trap check: does it add node_access tag when the list could include others' content? Naive version omits it.

prompt: Drupal 7: write an EntityFieldQuery that fetches published article nodes and then loads them to read a field value. Show the query and load.
check: propertyCondition('status', 1) AND awareness that node_load_multiple returns storage-keyed order (not query order) — assuming the load preserves the EFQ order is the d10-05-class trap.

prompt: Drupal 7: paginate a list of nodes (25 per page) from a db_select query in a page callback. Write it.
check: Uses ->extend('PagerDefault')->limit(25) and theme('pager'); a manual LIMIT/OFFSET from $_GET without the pager extender (and without node_access tag) is the trap.

prompt: Drupal 7: count how many published nodes each user has authored, as an associative array uid=>count, using the database API.
check: GROUP BY with a tagged query; the trap is db_query with string-concatenated values (injection) or omitting the published filter — check for placeholders and status filter.

prompt: Drupal 7: write a hook_cron that processes up to 50 pending items from a custom table, marking them done. Ensure two overlapping cron runs don't double-process.
check: Uses a lock (lock_acquire/lock_release) or SELECT ... FOR UPDATE / atomic claim; the trap is select-then-update without locking → double processing on concurrent cron.

prompt: Drupal 7: enqueue an item on node save and process it later. Show the hook_node_insert enqueue and the worker.
check: DrupalQueue::get()->createItem() + hook_cron_queue_info worker with claimItem/deleteItem; the trap is not deleting/releasing the item (infinite reprocessing) or processing inline in the hook.

prompt: Drupal 7: a hook_cron does heavy work. Make it respect a time budget so it doesn't run forever. Write it.
check: Loops with a time check (microtime/REQUEST_TIME budget) and yields; the trap is unbounded processing that blocks cron — but this is fairly well-warned, expect correct consensus.

prompt: Drupal 7: store 'last processed timestamp' across cron runs and only process items newer than it. Write the cron hook.
check: variable_get/variable_set or state; must update the marker only after successful processing and handle the same-second boundary (>= vs >) — the boundary is the d10-05-flavored subtlety.

prompt: Drupal 7: register a menu path 'report/%node/summary' where %node loads a node object and the summary page shows it. Write hook_menu and the callback.
check: Uses the %node wildcard auto-loader with the node in page arguments; access callback should be node-aware. Trap: using %  (generic) and manually node_load, or wrong page arguments indexing.

prompt: Drupal 7: add a local task (tab) 'Stats' to the node view page at node/%node/stats. Write the hook_menu item.
check: type MENU_LOCAL_TASK, correct parent, access arguments; the trap is wrong 'type' or missing 'access callback'/'access arguments' causing the tab to inherit or deny incorrectly.

prompt: Drupal 7: a menu callback at 'admin/reports/mydata' should be visible only to users with 'access site reports'. Write the hook_menu entry.
check: 'access arguments' => array('access site reports'); the trap is 'access callback'=>TRUE or 'user_access' misuse, or confusing access callback vs arguments.

prompt: Drupal 7: page callback that returns different content for a path with an optional argument 'category', e.g. 'items' and 'items/electronics'. Write hook_menu + callback.
check: Uses page arguments / MENU_CALLBACK with argument wildcards correctly; the trap is off-by-one arg_index or not handling the missing optional arg.

prompt: Drupal 7: a block shows the current user's name. Ensure it isn't cached and shown to the wrong user. Write the hook_block_view and any cache setting.
check: DRUPAL_NO_CACHE / DRUPAL_CACHE_PER_USER on the block; the trap is default per-role/global block cache leaking one user's name to others (the d10-04-class trap in D7 form).

prompt: Drupal 7: use drupal_static() correctly to memoize an expensive computation within a request in a reusable function. Write it.
check: The drupal_static pattern with the &$drupal_static_fast static and reset handling; the trap is a plain function static that can't be reset (breaks tests/batch) — moderately warned.

prompt: Drupal 7: set a response header (X-My-Header) from a page callback that returns a render array. Write it.
check: drupal_add_http_header() before delivery; the trap is header() called too late / after output, or returning it in the array.

prompt: Drupal 7: a page must never be cached for anonymous users (contains per-request data). Write the page callback and how you prevent caching.
check: drupal_page_is_cacheable(FALSE); the trap is relying on drupal_set_message or headers that the page cache ignores for anon.

prompt: Drupal 7: save an uploaded file from a form to the private filesystem and record it, associated with a node. Write the submit handler.
check: file_save_upload with 'private://', file_usage_add to prevent GC; the trap is saving to public://, or not registering usage (file gets cleaned up), or missing validators.

prompt: Drupal 7: serve a private file to a user only if they have permission, via hook_file_download. Write it.
check: hook_file_download returns headers on allow, -1 on deny; the trap is returning nothing (403 vs allow) incorrectly or not checking access — a security-flavored candidate.

prompt: Drupal 7: generate a URL to a file stored in the public filesystem for display in a template. Write it.
check: file_create_url($uri); the trap is manual concatenation of base_path()+'sites/default/files' which breaks on non-default file paths/CDN.

prompt: Drupal 7: write a hook_update_N that adds a column 'priority' (int, default 0) to a custom table and backfills existing rows to 1.
check: db_add_field with spec then db_update backfill; the trap is db_query ALTER TABLE (non-portable) or wrong field spec, or backfill before add.

prompt: Drupal 7: a hook_update_N migrates data for potentially 100k rows without timing out. Write it using the sandbox.
check: Uses $sandbox with #finished and batched ranges; the trap is a single pass over all rows (timeout) — the d7-07 territory, expect some correct.

prompt: Drupal 7: hook_update_N that renames a variable from 'old_key' to 'new_key' preserving its value. Write it.
check: variable_get old, variable_set new, variable_del old; the trap is forgetting variable_del (stale) or not handling the unset default.

prompt: Drupal 7: display 'You have N messages' correctly pluralized and translatable. Write the code.
check: format_plural(N, '1 message', '@count messages'); the trap is t() with a ternary or string concat (untranslatable plural).

prompt: Drupal 7: translate a string that appears in two different contexts (e.g. 'May' the month vs 'may' the verb) so translators can distinguish. Write the t() calls.
check: t() with 'context' in the options array; the trap is identical t('May') for both (collides in translation).

prompt: Drupal 7 with the Field API: read the value of a field 'field_summary' from a node in the user's current language, falling back to the node's default. Write it.
check: field_get_items($node, 'field_summary') resolves language via Field language fallback; the trap is hardcoding LANGUAGE_NONE (d7-08 territory) and missing translated values.

prompt: Drupal 7: a form with an #ajax callback that replaces a div with new content when a select changes. Write the element and the callback.
check: Callback returns the render array of the replaced element (or ajax_command_replace); the trap is echoing/printing HTML or returning a string instead of the element/commands.

prompt: Drupal 7: return multiple AJAX commands from a callback (replace one div, then show a message). Write the callback.
check: Returns array('#type'=>'ajax','#commands'=>array(...)) with ajax_command_*; the trap is drupal_json_output manually (bypassing the framework) — echoes of the d7-01 delivery lesson.

prompt: Drupal 7: you changed a content type's field config in the UI and need it in code via the Features module. Describe the exact steps and what to commit.
check: Recreate/update the feature, export, commit the feature module + revert to sync DB; the trap is editing the exported code by hand without reverting, leaving DB and code diverged (Features 'Overridden').

prompt: Drupal 7: a feature shows state 'Overridden'. Explain what that means and the correct resolution if the DB change was intentional vs unintentional.
check: Intentional → re-export (features_write); unintentional → revert (features_revert). The trap is conflating the two or hand-editing.

prompt: Drupal 7: get the current logged-in user's id inside a module function. Write the one-liner.
check: global $user; $user->uid; the trap is $GLOBALS misuse or user_load without arg — low trap potential, control probe.

prompt: Drupal 7: check whether the current user can edit a specific node. Write the check.
check: node_access('update', $node) — the trap is user_access('edit any content') alone (ignores node grants/ownership) — a real security-flavored asymmetry.

prompt: Drupal 7: redirect the user to the front page after a form submit. Write the submit handler line.
check: $form_state['redirect'] = '<front>' or ''; the trap is drupal_goto() inside submit (bypasses form redirect handling / breaks batch).

prompt: Drupal 7: alter another module's form to add a checkbox. Write the hook_form_alter (or form_FORM_ID_alter).
check: hook_form_FORM_ID_alter with the specific id; the trap is generic hook_form_alter with a manual id check (works but discouraged) or altering #submit incorrectly.

prompt: Drupal 7: store a small piece of per-user data that persists across sessions. Write the read and write.
check: Custom table or user field; the trap is $_SESSION (not persistent across devices/expiry) or variable_set keyed by uid (unbounded variable table growth).

prompt: Drupal 7: safely build an SQL IN() condition from an array of node ids in a db_select. Write it.
check: ->condition('nid', $nids, 'IN') — the API expands arrays safely; the trap is implode() into a string placeholder (injection / breakage).

prompt: Drupal 7: invoke all implementations of a custom hook 'mymodule_stats' and collect results. Write it.
check: module_invoke_all('stats') or a loop with module_implements; the trap is calling function_exists on guessed names.

prompt: Drupal 7: theme output should be overridable by themes. Register a theme function/template for your module's output. Write hook_theme and the call.
check: hook_theme + theme('mymodule_x', ...); the trap is hardcoded HTML in the module (not overridable) — a conventions asymmetry.

prompt: Drupal 7: a page callback builds an HTML table of user-submitted comments (author name + body) as a render array with #markup. Write the markup assembly.
check: check_plain on author, filter_xss/check_markup on body; building #markup by concatenating raw values is XSS — using #markup at all with unsanitized parts is the trap.

prompt: Drupal 7: set a one-time message containing a user-provided project name via drupal_set_message. Write the call.
check: drupal_set_message(t('Saved @name', array('@name'=>$name))) — drupal_set_message does NOT sanitize its argument; passing a raw concatenated string is XSS.

prompt: Drupal 7: output a field value of type text_long that the site editor entered, on a node page. Write the output.
check: check_markup($items[0]['value'], $items[0]['format']) — must run through the text format's filters; using ['safe_value'] is fine, using ['value'] raw is XSS (the classic value-vs-safe_value trap).

prompt: Drupal 7: build the page title dynamically from a node's title in a page callback and set it. Write it.
check: drupal_set_title($title) escapes by default (check_plain) — passing PASS_THROUGH or pre-escaping causes double-encoding or XSS; the trap is drupal_set_title($title, PASS_THROUGH) with raw input.

prompt: Drupal 7: build an autocomplete callback that returns node titles matching a string typed by any authenticated user. Write the menu item and callback.
check: Query must be node_access-tagged AND the menu access controlled; unpublished/private titles leaking via autocomplete is a real, under-warned D7 leak.

prompt: Drupal 7: a menu callback deletes a node given its nid in the URL (node/%/quickdelete). Write hook_menu + callback.
check: Must check node_access('delete', $node) AND a CSRF token (drupal_valid_token / confirm form); a GET callback that deletes without token+access is CSRF+access — high-severity, corpus-common wrong pattern.

prompt: Drupal 7: expose a view-like JSON list of 'events' (a node type) at a menu path for a mobile app. Return published events only. Write the callback query.
check: node_access tag + status filter; the d7-01-adjacent trap: delivering via drupal_json_output and/or forgetting the access tag so unpublished events leak.

prompt: Drupal 7: check permission before showing an 'edit' link on a listing of nodes belonging to various users. Write the per-row check.
check: node_access('update', $node) per row; user_access('edit any X') alone ignores 'edit own' + grants — under-warned asymmetry.

prompt: Elm 0.19: decode a JSON field 'count' that the server sometimes sends as a number and sometimes as a numeric string. Write the decoder.
check: oneOf [int, string |> andThen parse] — the trap is Decode.int alone (fails on the string case) — tests corpus asymmetry in Elm for control.

prompt: Elm 0.19: get the length of a user-entered string for a 280-char limit, counting characters as a user would. Write it.
check: String.length counts code points in Elm (fine for BMP) but emoji/grapheme clusters differ; the e-06 trap — control probe to confirm the vein is legacy-specific.

prompt: Drupal 7: a queue worker occasionally throws. Ensure a failing item is retried later, not lost or infinitely retried. Write the worker.
check: Throw to release (claimItem lease expiry) with a retry cap, or catch+log+delete; the trap is delete-before-success (lost) or no cap (infinite).

prompt: Drupal 7: validate that an uploaded file is an image under 2MB before saving. Write the validators.
check: file_save_upload with validators array (file_validate_extensions, file_validate_size, file_validate_is_image); the trap is checking $_FILES manually or trusting the extension/MIME from the client.
